Course information
Course number 80511412 Course sequence 0
Course title Technology and Strategy Course department/school/college School of Economics and Management
Instructor name Credit hours 32
Credit 2 Testing methods
Textbooks Melissa A. Schilling, Strategic Management of Technological Innovation, 4th ed, McGraw-Hill, 2013.
Reference books Scott Shane，Technology Strategy for Managers and Entrepreneurs, Pearson/Prentice Hall, 2009
Chinese description 技术密集型产业的竞争，包括：技术和竞争优势，技术杠杆，差距分析法；创造价值：技术和市场变化的模式，包括：S曲线和主导设计，市场的进化；获取价值：理解竞争，包括：独占性和价值获得，标准驱动的市场竞争；传递价值：组织竞争力；技术战略设计和实施。
English description Analyze the technologies strategies of leading firms, and the relationships between technologies strategies, competitive strategies, and firm growth; answer how a firm could become a technology leader, how to nurture autonomous innovation and induced innovation, how to deal with open innovation.
Course features 01
